messages:
Evelyn (Finance): FYI we received an invoice from LagosData (LD-222 NG). They included a note: 'Invoice net USD 9,000, vendor requests gross-up for 10% withholding'. No supporting docs attached. Who should we ask for what?
Priya (Accounts Payable): Please request their Nigerian TIN and a tax clearance or proof of remittance. Also ask for a reissued invoice showing VAT breakdown or a zero-rated export annotation.
Marco (Vendor Ops): Vendor claims services rendered in Nigeria. They say local withholding applies to cross-border payments per their tax counsel. No certificate attached.
Hassan (Legal): We need either a Nigerian Tax Clearance Certificate or a Certificate of Residence (if treaty relief claimed). If they're asking us to gross-up, that's a contract change; require approval and a written amendment.
TaxBot: Auto-check: No US W-8/W-9 required for Nigerian vendor. Withholding in Nigeria can be imposed for certain services; supplier should provide proof. Recommend hold payment until documentation.
Evelyn (Finance): OK action items: Marco to request docs, Priya holds payment, Hassan will assess if gross-up clause is needed. Marco please send vendor the checklist.
Marco (Vendor Ops): Sent message to vendor: 
```
Hi LagosData,
Thanks for the invoice. To process we need: 1) Nigerian TIN and Tax Clearance/Receipt; 2) reissued invoice showing VAT line or explicit zero-rate justification; 3) if you require a gross-up, provide the legal basis and a sample calculation and a proposed contract amendment.
Please reply within 48h.
```
Priya (Accounts Payable): Blocking payment in the AP system now.
Evelyn (Finance): Thanks everyone. Will monitor thread.
